description: Optional FreeBuff account id sent as x-freebuff-acting-user-id. BAN RISK: only the token's own account id is safe (any other value impersonates another user). Pre-rename name USER_ID still works. Empty = header omitted.
When AUTH_TOKENS is empty, read credentials from the official CLI login files (false disables). Environment-only: it controls whether .env is read at all, so a .env line is inert outside Docker.
Upstream CLI version string; informational only — parsed and shown on the dashboard, no wire impact.
Serve the embedded admin dashboard at /admin (false disables all /admin routes with 404). Restart-only: /admin routes are registered once at boot and cannot be torn down at runtime.
Persist redacted traffic dumps to ./dump/ (mode 0600, debugging only).
Show the Dev Tools page (batch chat, session spawner) in the admin dashboard. Default off: it is a manual testing surface that hammers /v1/*.
HTTP read timeout for client request bodies (far-away clients uploading large prompts/images need more; 0 disables). Set via container environment.
Host and port to bind (loopback by default; containers set :3457 for all interfaces). Set via container environment. The listener socket is bound once at boot and never re-binds on reload.
Log one access line per HTTP request (healthz/metrics/OPTIONS are rate-limited to 1/min regardless).
Append log lines to a file (e.g. ./logs/proxy.log); empty = stderr. Restart-only: the log sink is opened once at boot and a reload never re-opens it.
Log format: text (key=value, colored) or json (one JSON object per line). Restart-only: the logger is configured once at boot and a reload never reconfigures it.
Log level (trace = wire-level bodies). Restart-only: the logger is configured once at boot and a reload never reconfigures it.

Apply the anti-ban preset when a knob is left unset: idle-run rotation 30m, request jitter 200ms. TLS is CLI-faithful (plain Go/Bun baseline; set TLS_FINGERPRINT=auto for browser-evasion on datacenter IPs). Keep on.
Adopt the upstream CLI's active session (from freebuff-instance-owner.json) instead of creating a new one; with empty AUTH_TOKENS the token is sourced from the CLI credentials file.
Comma-separated client keys required for /v1/* (empty = open; ignored in bridge mode). Managed in the Overview and Client API Keys section.
Comma-separated upstream FreeBuff tokens. Managed in the Pool page and Device Login.
With AUTH_TOKENS set, accept bridge-mode clients (their own token relayed) alongside the pool — hybrid mode. 0 = locked-down pooled-only instance.
How long a bridge entry may sit unused before its runs are FINISHed and it is evicted from the cache (sliding TTL; zero or invalid → 72h).

Ceiling for any cooldown derived from upstream retry fields, in milliseconds (7d = 604800000). Untrusted upstream values are clamped here so an absurd Retry-After cannot park a token for years. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 604800000. Applies live on reload.

Token cooldown on upstream region block (country_blocked), in milliseconds (15m = 900000): long enough to stop the hammer, short enough to re-probe after an egress switch. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 900000. Applies live on reload.
Token cooldown on upstream auth rejection, in milliseconds (30m = 1800000). Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 1800000. Applies live on reload.

Backoff for a free_mode_run_fanout refusal without a Retry-After header, in milliseconds (1m = 60000): the upstream run counter clears in seconds, and re-hitting it feeds a ban-grade sweep signal. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 60000. Applies live on reload.

Backoff for a free_mode_invalid_agent_model refusal without a Retry-After header, in milliseconds (1m = 60000): retrying sooner only amplifies the 403 storm. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 60000. Applies live on reload.

+/-fraction of retryAfterMs applied to the ip_capped re-admission window so concurrent tokens do not re-admit in lockstep (default 0.2 = 20%). Negative values reject the config. Applies live on reload.

How many times one token may re-admit (and be refused ip_capped again) per Pacific day before it locks until the next Pacific midnight (default 3). Negative values reject the config. Applies live on reload.

Backoff for a 429 load-saturation refusal, in milliseconds (90s = 90000): upstream sheds load for minutes, not a day. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 90000. Applies live on reload.

Backoff for a 429 with no timestamp, daily-reset signal, or Retry-After header, in milliseconds (1m = 60000): a fully opaque body must never lock the token until Pacific midnight. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 60000. Applies live on reload.

Backoff for a 429 peak-hours refusal, in milliseconds (30m = 1800000): the peak lasts hours and its end is not in the body, so re-probe conservatively instead of locking until midnight. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 1800000. Applies live on reload.
Finish runs after this idle period (0 = disabled; SAFE_MODE sets 30m when unset).

How long the nightly maturity walk pauses after a rate-limited touch, in milliseconds (3m = 180000): the walk aborts instead of hammering a throttled upstream. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 180000. Applies live on reload.

Global kill-switch for the nightly streak-maintenance run (the ONLY streak control): every account is classified automatically once nightly in the 15 minutes before the Pacific-midnight reset (23:45-00:00), and eligible accounts fire one live touch in the final 5 minutes. Default true (live touches); set false to disable all automated touches.
DEPRECATED (hidden): the streak is universally automatic now — per-account targets are dead, every account is touched nightly. Kept parsed for compat; this value is unused.

Global touch model for the nightly run: empty (default, same as "auto") admits the cheapest served price-0/exempt row per account and falls back to this key's explicit value when no unmetered served row exists; an explicit provider/model id overrides auto. The touch never spends Freebucks (fail-closed on priced rows). Accounts with client traffic since the last Pacific reset are skipped, as are quarantined/banned/cooling/country-blocked/locked ones.

Pin pool slots to models (slot-indexed allowlist, e.g. "0:z-ai/glm-5.2;1:upstage/solar-pro4,mimo/mimo-v2.5"). Slots without an entry serve any model. Applies live on reload; malformed values reject the config.
How long a model_unavailable admission refusal is remembered per model (off-window models short-circuit to the fallback within the TTL).

Cap on parked FIFO waiters per token for smart-routing live-turn slots (0 = no queueing: fail over at once when no slot is free; negative rejects the config). A full queue fails over with the existing 429 shape. Applies live on reload.

How long one acquire parks on a full token's FIFO live-turn queue before failing over with the existing 429 shape (Go duration, e.g. 5s, 30s). Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 30s. Applies live on reload.

Master switch for the activity-aware quota prober: a busy pool probes every QUOTA_PROBE_ACTIVE_INTERVAL, a warming pool every 5m, an idle pool once plus the QUOTA_PROBE_IDLE_HEARTBEAT heartbeat. Applies live on reload; false restores pre-scheduler behavior (manual probes only).

How often each pooled token is quota-probed while the pool is busy (traffic under 2m ago). Go duration (default 60s); the warming cadence stays 5m, idle is covered by QUOTA_PROBE_IDLE_HEARTBEAT. Applies live on reload.

How often each pooled token is quota-probed while the pool sits idle (no traffic for 15m or more): one probe fires when traffic stops, then only this heartbeat until traffic resumes. Go duration (default 30m, also the ceiling for 429-backoff doubling). Applies live on reload.
Burst request capacity per client IP (0 = defaults to 2 × RATE_LIMIT_PER_IP).

Rotate to another available token when an in-flight request hits a token-level 429 (rate limit / throttle). turn_spend_limited is TERMINAL (upstream per-turn spend breaker — a retry re-trips instantly) and is excluded from failover (default true).
Requests/second allowed per client IP (0 = disabled; e.g. 20).
Agent-run rotation interval.

Master switch for smart pool routing: per-token live-turn slots with a FIFO waiter queue plus the unified scorer over eligible tokens. Applies live on reload; false restores the legacy acquire path exactly.
Draining-runs list cap; entries beyond it are force-dropped (FINISH is best-effort).
Draining-runs TTL eviction window.
Synchronous inline FINISH fallback bound when the deferred-FINISH queue is full.
Bounded deferred-FINISH worker queue for rotated/drained runs (full queue falls back to a synchronous FINISH).
End upstream sessions after this idle period, freeing the account while the proxy sits unused (0 = disabled, opt-in).

Park short-cooldown sessions instead of dropping them (default true): a parked session keeps its row and retries on backoff, so brief 5-15m cooldowns never cause an instant session loss. Fatal refusals (ban, spend-exhausted, endsTheSession) stay terminal regardless. Applies live on reload.

Park-vs-drop boundary in milliseconds (15m = 900000): a session whose computed cooldown is at or below this parks and never drops (while SESSION_PARK_ENABLED). Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 900000. Applies live on reload.
Persist session state AND active agent runs to disk so a restart resumes them instead of re-creating (default true). Set via container environment.

Cap on the session-liveness poll failure backoff in milliseconds (5m = 300000): consecutive failures double from 20s up to this ceiling. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 300000. Applies live on reload.
Reuse the last successful quota probe (skip redundant upstream status GETs) within this window.
Re-admit a session pre-emptively when less than this remains: the request rides the old session while the refresh runs in the background.
Path of the session state file (used when SESSION_PERSIST=true; token-keyed, 0600, raw tokens never written).

Ceiling for the quota-probe 429-backoff doubling in milliseconds (30m = 1800000): effective probe intervals never sleep longer than this. Zero-tolerant: empty or non-positive values fall back to 1800000. Applies live on reload.

Cap on concurrent live turns per pooled token (default 2, the approved anti-ban pacing; 0 = unlimited, no slot gating at all). A lease is granted only while the token holds fewer live turns; excess waiters park FIFO until QUEUE_WAIT elapses. Applies live on reload. BUNKER PRESET: 1 — fully sequential turns per account, zero parallel fingerprint.
Token selection strategy: drain (exhaust a token's session before rotating), round_robin, least_used, or random. Managed interactively on the Pool page.
After an upstream 428 waiting_room_required, fire the reference ad-chain + streak requests before the next session create (best-effort, never blocks).
Add {"type":"ephemeral"} cache_control to the stable context prefix on DeepSeek requests (prompt-cache cost reduction; default on). Set CACHE_CONTROL_INJECTION=false to disable.
Apply optional prompt & context compression: middle user/assistant turns beyond the trailing budget are dropped and summarized by one marker (default off).
MUST stay "free": any other value routes requests as PAID and fresh free accounts get 402 "Out of credits".
Negotiate HTTP/2 with the upstream so the ALPN matches real browsers; false forces HTTP/1.1.
Comma-separated model allowlist: when set, only these resolved model ids are served and any other request is rejected with 404 model_not_found. Empty = all models allowed.
/v1/models prunes models marked unavailable (region/tier demotion, quota exhaustion); off by default so a stale signal never hides a working model.
Fold reasoning_content into message content as <tag>...</tag> for clients that do not render a reasoning channel. "true" uses <think>; a tag word (e.g. "thinking") sets the label; empty/off disables.
Model catalog refresh interval.
Random delay range [0, REQUEST_JITTER) before upstream chat calls; SAFE_MODE sets 200ms when unset; 0 disables.
Upstream response-header (TTFB) timeout; the streamed chat body runs until upstream finishes or the client disconnects (never cut by this knob).
Session call timeout.
TLS fingerprint for upstream egress (empty = plain Go/Bun baseline, CLI-faithful; auto/browser values use utls to mimic browser JA3 for WAF evasion on datacenter IPs).
Max additional attempts after a transient transport failure (never retries 429/403/401; 0 disables).
Upstream API endpoint (codebuff.com is normalized to www.codebuff.com).

Force Secure on the admin session and CSRF cookies even over plain HTTP (true/1/yes). Environment-only: read straight from the process environment with a .env fallback on every request, so a dashboard-saved value applies live unless the process env overrides it. Set it when terminating TLS at a reverse proxy that talks HTTP to the gateway.
Login password for the admin dashboard and the bearer token POST /admin/reload requires. Managed via the Security settings card.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin for /v1/* responses.
Enforce password authentication for the admin dashboard. When false, loopback clients access the dashboard without login (open mode). When true, dashboard requires password. Defaults to true.
Best-effort alert POSTs for pool_exhausted, token_banned, and agent_model_mismatch_escalation (empty = disabled; at most one POST per event type per 5m; may carry credentials in the URL userinfo).
